rca of the issue: Reproduction: Login customer, add cart item, open /checkout. App shows emergent runtime overlay and React warning for <Checkout>. Console captures PAGE ERROR: 'object is not iterable (cannot read property Symbol(Symbol.iterator))'. In App.js checkout component, hook is used as array destructuring (`const [Razorpay] = useRazorpay();`), while current react-razorpay 3.0.1 docs indicate object return shape (`const { Razorpay, isLoading, error } = useRazorpay();`). This mismatch likely crashes rendering before payment controls mount. Mitigation: align destructuring with installed hook API, then rerun checkout/UPI verification. Also note: Razorpay external payment/QR/app redirect execution remained MOCKED by requirement and was not executed live.
